_about: Screening criteria for the Infra Deal Screener. Edit this file to retarget the tool at another sub-sector or fund. Built with the thesis-development, market-map-and-sourcing and deal-screening skills.

segments.61200: Wireless networks, towers and fixed wireless
segments.63110: Data centres, data processing and hosting
segments.42220: Building and maintaining telecoms and utility networks

size_band_gbp.note: Turnover comes from filed accounts in a later step; the bulk company file has no financials.

ebitda_rule.loss_making_network_owners: Send to a separate watchlist, not the shortlist

scoring_notes.revenue_visibility: PROVISIONAL: estimated from the type of business until contract mix, customer concentration and renewal data are available
scoring_notes.strategy_fit: Thesis relevance; only IN and ADJACENT companies are ranked
scoring_notes.margin_quality: EBITDA margin level (70%) and margin stability across three or more years where history is available (30%; neutral where not)
scoring_notes.balance_sheet: Balance sheet resilience: positive net assets, cash cover and margin headroom, reduced where interest cover is below 3x. Not yet true debt capacity (needs net debt, capex and cash conversion)

pricing: Walk-away multiple to be set from disclosed deals before any named company is screened
method_version: v3 (24 Nov 2026): data quality moved out of the score into a confidence rating; size on EBITDA; margin stability from multi-year history; sector gate; debt capacity renamed balance sheet resilience

sector_gate.otherwise: Listed separately as needing a sector check, not ranked

size_ebitda_gbp.note: Turnover band still applies as the hard stop; size fit now scores EBITDA, the base a buyer prices off

confidence.note: How far the inputs can be trusted. Shown beside the score, never added to it.
